identity.description: A service account stages and runs deepce.sh from /tmp/deepce.sh — delivered through the Cortex POV payload shelf (sha256-pinned 2c8301c3e8d12c01…, adapter TOOL-DEEPCE) rather than an inline internet download, so the attack survives the customer's default-deny egress and the absent detection is never a manufactured false negative. Cortex should detect the execution of this tool from a writable path and its file hash.

payload.code:
# MATURE: the tool is deployed WITH the payload via the digest-pinned payload shelf.
# SimCore stages deepce.sh to /tmp/deepce.sh (sha256 2c8301c3e8d12c01…); this payload only runs it.
set -euo pipefail
[ -s /tmp/deepce.sh ] || { echo '[FATAL] PAYLOAD_NOT_STAGED_ON_TARGET:/tmp/deepce.sh — the TTP did NOT run; absent detections are NOT a Cortex miss' >&2; exit 1; }
sha256sum /tmp/deepce.sh
sh /tmp/deepce.sh --no-color   # enumerate container-escape paths (docker.sock, caps, mounts)

biocs.name: Payload-Shelf Tool deepce.sh Executed From a Writable Path by a Service Account
biocs.description: A non-root service account executes deepce.sh from /tmp/deepce.sh — a privilege-escalation/container-breakout tool staged into a writable path, distinct from normal admin tooling.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_path contains "/tmp/deepce.sh" or action_process_image_path contains "/tmp/deepce.sh"
| filter actor_effective_username != "root"
| comp count() as execs by agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, actor_process_image_path
| filter execs >= 1

abiocs.name: First-Seen Execution of a Privesc/Escape Tool From /tmp on This Host
abiocs.description: A host that has never run deepce.sh suddenly executes it from a writable path moments after the file is staged — the stage→chmod→exec chain of a deployed offensive tool.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("sh","bash") and action_process_image_path contains "deepce.sh"
| comp count() as first_runs by agent_hostname, action_process_image_path
abiocs.causality_anchor: payload-shelf file-write of /tmp/deepce.sh -> chmod +x -> first execution of deepce.sh by a service-account shell

xql_queries.name: Staged deepce.sh Execution on the Endpoint Feed
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_path contains "deepce.sh"
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_path, action_process_command_line
